title: 390 Adventure SW
description: Within the Adventure Tourer segment, the KTM 390 Adventure SW is engineered for uncompromised trans-continental exploration. Its tuned powertrain delivers immediate, tractable torque against its responsive chassis architecture, ensuring responsive roll-on acceleration in demanding road conditions. The cockpit is configured with an Aggressive Forward Tuck stance and a commanding 855mm perch delivering excellent ground clearance and expansive sightlines, prioritizing aerodynamic tuck and front-end circuit precision over casual urban commuting.
